authority: OWNER-GRAPHITE-TEST-WAVE-02 §3 (#564); the Test Lead's VAL-D13 ruling, 2026-10-04, registered as a versioned policy at the owner's direction
notes: Levels 0-3: only Carbon's own trainer writes the pod's claim, so it is admissible; a program failure stays the candidate's so a recipe that crashes the trainer cannot buy infrastructure semantics (Track A selective crash/retry).
Levels 4-5 or an unknown level: a claim on an image without a SEPARATED_IMAGES record is evidence only.
Timeouts follow the retry rule at every level; only a host-confirmed repeat is the candidate's, never scored.
Whether this policy is exploitable is for the Attacker's resource and accounting families to test; a change is a new registered version.
